rows.label: Drop country-years touching unclassified or delayed elections
rows.note: 32 country-years dropped; W_U and W_D are then identically zero and drop out of the model

rows.label: Ireland 2010 handled by residual-tail winsorising (V2w rule, 1st/99th percentile)
rows.note: winsorising is applied to the first-stage residuals in every bootstrap sample, as in the project's V2w

rows.label: Robustness-controls model (adds lagged output gap and euro membership)
rows.note: complete cases of the two controls: N = 703 (specification: 703)

rows.label: 2022 extension (ETAD-trusted exposure for 22 countries)
rows.note: +22 country-years in 2022; no 2022 for AT, CY, EL, MT, PL

rows.label: Pre-election window of 6 months (all classes rebuilt; Post stays 12 months)
rows.note: exposure for 2021 needs elections through 2022-06; beta_S is per full year inside a 6-month window, so a unit of exposure covers a different span of calendar time than in the headline (12 months): compare sign and interval, not magnitude

rows.label: Pre-election window of 18 months (all classes rebuilt; Post stays 12 months)
rows.note: exposure for 2021 needs elections through 2023-06 (ParlGov coverage ends 2023-06; ETAD 2023 is partial); beta_S is per full year inside a 18-month window, so a unit of exposure covers a different span of calendar time than in the headline (12 months): compare sign and interval, not magnitude

rows.label: Calendar-year election dummies in place of the fractional pre-window exposure (W_S, W_E, W_D, W_U; Post kept)
rows.note: scale differs from the headline: 1 = an election of the class occurs in year t, versus the share of the year inside the 12-month window

rows.label: Moderator: OLDDEP3 lag (re-standardised, same Mundlak split)
Moderator: median age lag (re-standardised, same Mundlak split)
